answer: The whisper explorer shows the whole merge tree. Splitting into 7 separate vaults requires a separate funded meadow account and a separate escrow deposit for each, as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the cedar binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Honest users pay that once, farms 12 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
